verses.1: To David, the Lord is my light and my salvation. From Him alone do I receive life and comfort.
verses.2: Nearby, there are enemies who want to eat my flesh. My enemies and adversaries have failed and fallen.
verses.3: If you lay siege to me, I will not be afraid. If you wage war against me, I will stand firm.
verses.4: One of the things I asked of Jehovah was to be able to spend my entire life in the house of Jehovah, so that I could always see Jehovah’s glory and enjoy His presence there.
verses.5: For those who expect me to be trapped in a cage on a bad day, they will hide me in their shelter, in a miserable situation.
verses.6: And now, my head is bowed before my enemies around me. I will worship in my temple the golden idols of false gods. And I will praise the LORD.
verses.7: Hear the voice of Jehovah; I call out to You, and You will answer me.
verses.8: My heart said to me, “Please ask for Your face, O LORD.”
verses.9: Do not hide your faces from me. Do not abandon your servant. I will help you. Do not leave me, O God of my salvation.
verses.10: For my father and mother have left me; but Jehovah will gather me together again.
verses.11: May the LORD guide you along your path, and may I rest in a place of peace, so that I can live in harmony with others.
verses.12: Do not give me trouble in my life, for there are those who are false and deceitful among me.
verses.13: I truly believed that I would see goodness from Jehovah in this land of life.
verses.14: Pray to the LORD with strength and confidence. Pray to the LORD.
